confirmed_defects.evidence: mediaShell.style.cssText = '' clears the cloned template's authoritative --media-frame-* variables before incomplete rebinding
runtime writes legacy mediaRole and layout variables but not the complete actual-item role/kind/fit/crop/ratio/source/focal/resource-state/root-fallback protocol
applyRuntimeRelatedLayout and createEventCardElement assign image.style.objectFit and image.style.objectPosition directly
serialized onload changes classes and aria-busy but does not publish resource-state=loaded or remove canonical root fallback state
the no-image branch removes src/width/height and alt only; it does not publish fallback kind/fit/crop reason/resource state or clear stale favicon metadata
no canonical broken transition prevents stale visual/cover/pending/favicon dimensions and role from surviving a failed runtime resource

delivery_semantics.reason: the exact source-bound preview is required as a factual DRIFT specimen and for independently acceptable unaffected vertical slices

allowed_source: one bounded A0 runtime-clone regression file
correction_contract.implementation_shape: one local EventLayout runtime binding helper reused by createEventCardElement and applyRuntimeRelatedLayout
required_authoritative_rebinding: role from actual item media evidence
kind from actual item media evidence
crop permission and exact crop reason
frame ratio from current presentation decision
source width, height and ratio only when actual dimensions are known
object and focal position from the accepted decision
clear all stale template source dimensions, role, kind, ratio, fit, crop and state before rebinding

required_resource_transitions.successful_load: loaded; remove root fallback marker; hide direct fallback; preserve authoritative semantic and crop evidence
required_resource_transitions.network_error_or_unusable_decode: broken + kind=fallback + fit=contain + crop-permission=forbidden + crop-reason=resource_load_error + centered position + root fallback + visible direct fallback + failed src/srcset removed
required_resource_transitions.no_usable_source: fallback + kind=fallback + fit=contain + crop-permission=forbidden + crop-reason=runtime_event_card_fallback + centered position + root fallback + visible direct fallback

remove_duplicate_ownership: fit is applied through data-media-frame-fit and media-frame.css
position is applied through --media-frame-object-position and media-frame.css
preserve_behavior: EventCard DOM, typography, actions and metadata
personal-feed, related-continuation and authorized-search identity and order
links, calendar, share and feedback hooks

required: no runtime style.objectFit or style.objectPosition assignment remains
visual, document, unknown, missing and broken cloned cards publish the complete actual-item protocol
URL-present clone begins pending and successful load becomes loaded
missing source becomes fallback with direct visible fallback anatomy
failure becomes broken, fallback, contain, forbidden, resource_load_error and removes the failed resource
no stale favicon role, source dimensions, ratio, fit, crop reason or pending state survives rebinding
canonical clone, personal-feed, related-layout and authorized-search regressions remain green

required_runtime_consumers: at least one client-created personal-feed or authorized-search EventCard
at least one client-created related-continuation EventCard
record: actual MediaFrame role, kind, fit, crop permission and crop reason
resource state after hydration and after successful or failed resource transition
root fallback marker and direct fallback visibility
absence of stale favicon template metadata

revert_only: EventLayout runtime helper and call-site rebinding
